name: qr-code-generator
description: Generate deterministic, decoder-verified QR assets with safe visual themes and optional host-generated backgrounds.

interface.shortDescription: Create styled QR codes that are actually scannable.
interface.longDescription: Preserves an exact user payload, renders deterministic QR SVG/PNG variants with bounded themes, optionally routes decorative backgrounds through the host image capability without exposing the payload, and verifies the final asset with a real decoder before calling it usable.
defaultPrompt: Create a decoder-verified QR code for this URL.
Make a high-contrast themed QR code for my restaurant menu.
Create image-generation-assisted QR concepts, but never expose the payload.
